nearby_alternatives: If a Bay County site lacks a needed characteristic, check upstream Saginaw River sites in Saginaw County (e.g. USGS-04157005, Saginaw River at Holland Avenue at Saginaw, MI, listed on the WQP) or Saginaw Bay Monitoring Consortium tributary sites (Saginaw Valley State University, sampling began summer 2023) - confirm their availability in the Water Quality Portal first.
